seed.tagline: Roles, row-level security and magic-link sign-in from your rulebook.
seed.description: Adds an auth/ folder: the rulebook's Security module (roles, table and field permissions, row filters, context variables) compiled to effortless-rbac.json and then to Postgres roles, grants, app.* identity helpers and row-level security policies; plus magic-link.json, the sign-in endpoints and JWT issuer for your magic-link tenant. Needs the Security module enabled in the rulebook.
seed.requiresInput: A magic-link tenant id (from magiclink.effortlessapi.com) and the rulebook's Security module

replacements.label: Magic-link tenant id
replacements.description: Your tenant on magiclink.effortlessapi.com. Public: the app fetches the tenant's public key from it to verify sign-in tokens.

replacements.label: Which tables hold people?
replacements.description: The rulebook tables whose rows are users who sign in (comma-separated). Their email field is matched to the verified email in the sign-in token.
